result:
`validateApp` now throws if `owner` is missing or empty. The core shell, billing and reports apps now pass an owner, and the epic is closed with all four child tickets done. PR #1 (mono) passed CI and merged. CD on main succeeded.

- **One PR instead of ordered ones:** I put the contract change and all three app updates in a single PR. `libs/shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and is inlined into each app at build time, so there's no package to publish or version to bump. Merging the contract change alone would have left the apps calling a stricter `validateApp` without an owner.
- **Reports app:** `apps/sub-route-reports` also calls `validateApp` but had no child ticket, so I fixed it in the same PR. CD only builds and deploys core-shell and billing, so I can't confirm the reports change reached the CDN.
- **Owner names are guesses:** nothing in the repo says who owns what. I used `platform` for the core shell, `billing` for billing and `reports` for reports. Someone should confirm or correct them.
- **platform-kit:** `libs-platform-kit` doesn't use `validateApp`, so it needed no change.
- **Ticket 4 not exercised:** I didn't run any of the apps, so "still starts up" is only covered by the CI build. I marked PLAT-103-4 done after checking by search that every caller passes an owner.
